1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in S.T. No.1594 of 2023 arising out of Fir No.186 of
2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Pisawan, District
Sitapur.

sentences.text: 3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant 2 years ago and subsequently on 04.06.2023, she was hanged to death.

The cause of death as per the postmortem report is shown as asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature Aneesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Home ... on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112649379/

sentences.text: 1 mark, no other injury was visible on the body of the deceased.

4. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the co-accused Suman, the mother-in-law, has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 20.09.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.11304 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.11304 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the the fact that there was no material on record to suggest that the victim was harassed mentally or physically soon before death in relation to the demand of dowry at the instance of the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 19.06.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Aneesh be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.2.2024 akverma  Aneesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Home ...
